answer: One mind wearing many masks leaks a shared plume: when a single inference pipeline drives a hundred identities, their answer timing, token cadence, and error quirks correlate like a beacon in the noise. The economy seeds epoch-specific probes across thin panels and clusters responses by latency and stylistic signature; masks whose output fingerprints collapse onto one source get accrual frozen. The attacker must then run a genuinely independent model per identity, turning a cheap fork into a costly relic of real compute.
